rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a machine that washes clothes.

example.english: The washing machine is broken, so I’ll take the clothes to the laundromat tomorrow.
example.traditional: 部洗衣機壞咗，我聽日先拎啲衫去洗衣店。
